General Scoring Notes
The model solution is presented using standard mathematical notation.
Answers (numeric or algebraic) need not be simplified. Answers given as a decimal approximation should be
correct to three places afterthe decimal point. Within each individual free-response question, at most one
point is not earned for inappropriate rounding.

linear for 0 ≤ x ≤ 7. Let R be the region inthe second quadrantbounded by the graph of f, the vertical line
x = -6, and the x- and y-axes. Region R has area 12.
